workarounds.symptom: [GHSA-7xgj-8392-5q4r] FastMCP: Post-transform component authorization is skipped on direct calls (Affects fastmcp < 4.1.2)
workarounds.workaround: Upgrade fastmcp to patched release >= 4.1.2: pip install --upgrade 'fastmcp>=4.1.2' (Advisory: GHSA-7xgj-8392-5q4r)

workarounds.symptom: [GHSA-vqqp-x5qm-5qp4] FastMCP MCP client wrappers construct M2M OAuth providers without issuer binding — client secret redirectable to attacker-advertised authorization server (Affects fastmcp < 4.1.2)
workarounds.workaround: Upgrade fastmcp to patched release >= 4.1.2: pip install --upgrade 'fastmcp>=4.1.2' (Advisory: GHSA-vqqp-x5qm-5qp4)

workarounds.symptom: FastMCP python sidecar on Windows can emit CRLF line endings on stdio transport, corrupting JSON-RPC framing in strict MCP clients.
workarounds.workaround: Configure sys.stdout to binary write mode (sys.stdout.reconfigure(newline='\n')) or switch to remote Streamable HTTP transport.

workarounds.symptom: [GHSA-vv7q-7jx5-f767] FastMCP OpenAPI Provider has an SSRF & Path Traversal Vulnerability (Affects fastmcp < 3.2.0)
workarounds.workaround: Upgrade fastmcp to patched release >= 3.2.0: pip install --upgrade 'fastmcp>=3.2.0' (Advisory: GHSA-vv7q-7jx5-f767)

workarounds.workaround: Upgrade fastmcp to patched release >= 3.2.0: pip install --upgrade 'fastmcp>=3.2.0' (Advisory: GHSA-rww4-4w9c-7733)
